196. The Great Serpent, Ameris(4)
"I don't know what you mean."
When Valeria spoke, Jin took a moment to explain the conversations he had with Ameris to her.
“……Ah, so you mean that the obsession of the Sun God is also embedded in me?”

[Yes. The obsession of the Sun God I've seen so far has always been two kinds. An obsession to deny death, and an obsession to preserve it. But in your case…… a more complex will is intertwined. A will to observe and record something, that kind of will.]
Suddenly, Jin recalled what Orgal had said in the past when he was explaining about the sanctuary.
-[Yes, the sanctuary of Ziphil. Fully open complete magic bodies are almost immortal as long as they can use that space. They can recover all wounds just by staying in the sanctuary.]
-Is there a special reason why only the complete magic bodies react to residual energy?

-[Well, I don't know why either. I guess it's because some will of that existence is embedded among the owners of the complete magic bodies. Perhaps the complete magic body is a blessing granted only to those whose existence is permeated by that will.]
Valeria too, was recalling how she had healed her fatal injury by going to Ziphil's 'sanctuary'.
"Observation and recording...."
These words meant the mission given to Valeria as a Hister.
[Yes, Valeria Hister. It may be difficult for you to understand, but it is of great significance to me that I met you now and confirmed that unique obsession.]
"What is the relationship between my mission and Ameris's destiny?"

[I have always been curious about the obsession of the Sun God. I didn't know why he died. As far as I know, there was no one in the world who could kill him. Then, he must have chosen death himself, but why did the regret of wanting to deny death remain as an obsession.]
This was the question that Ameris had pondered for the longest time.
She was the one who grieved the most when the Sun God died, but she had to take on the role of guarding the new 'incomplete order'.
Reluctantly bearing the weight of fate, she could only think about the Sun God's death and his will.
If the Sun God chose to stop existing, why did the obsession remain, and if someone killed him, how was it possible.
In the former case, only the obsession to maintain death should remain, and in the latter case, only the obsession to deny death should remain.
Ameris had no choice but to continue her arduous battle without finding an answer.
But now, Ameris was getting a clue through Valeria.

[I still don't know the details of how the Sun God died. However, what the special obsession left in you means is clear. He wants to observe this world through you. What's happening in the world that has lost its perfection, what wind is blowing, what life is being born.]
“Ah.”

[Also, it's not madness or resentment, but a view full of affection for the creatures. Since it's a will to look at an existence you don't love, the obsession you have is as clear and brilliant as it can reflect anything.]
Ameris was shedding tears. Her long-standing painful contemplation was finally coming to an end.
"But I have never felt the will of the being called the Sun God. I have healed my wounds in Ziphil's sanctuary where his residual energy remains....”

[What he wants through you is to observe the creatures, not to change this world. The Sun God wanted to remain a silent observer after exiting this world. He gave freedom to the creatures… so they wouldn't be bound to fate like us immortals.]
The question of why God gave humans free will is a common theme found in many religions on earth. Ameris seemed to have gotten her own answer to that problem.
A moment of silence passed.
"Hmm! Anyway, you're saying that the will of something great is embodied in the redhead? I don't know why they entrusted it to such an unlucky kid."
[You, a mortal, don't need to know all of his will that even I don't know, Sandra Ziphil.]

“Ah, but it's strange, isn't it? Okay, let's say he chose the redhead. Or maybe he chose the whole lineage of the fairy tribe and the redhead. Because only fairies and Hister can use record magic. But why does the obsession to deny death exist?”
[I don't know. But what's important is the fact that among the obsessions left by the Sun God, the one to maintain this world is greater.]

"It seems the Sun God was a pretty ambiguous deity. Either it's maintenance or destruction. Or is he playing it by ear? Watching the world through the redhead's lineage, if it's not good, he resurrects and creates a perfect world again. Destroying everything here."
At Sandra's outspoken remark, Ameris was momentarily lost for words.
[That's a harsh story. But it's not without merit. If what you say is true, the Sun God faced an unwanted death, and in the process, the good wills……]
"That's strange, too! Then the obsessions to maintain death don't make sense. And you said there was no existence that could kill the Sun God."
[I just said, that's not what's important. Whether it's one way or another, what we have to do is prevent the resurrection of the Sun God and maintain this world.]
"Well, I agree."
It's still unknown whether the death of the Sun God was suicide or murder. This is because the remaining obsessions, as Sandra's logic goes, are conflicting.
However, in the midst of it all, Ameris found in her unjust fate a hint of comfort.
[Sandra Ziffel, was it? You're a mortal who's not only blunt but also endearing.]
"I'll take that as a compliment."
[Hedo must have had a tough time.]
"Well then, Ameris, what do you plan to do now?"
Jin asked as he looked around.
The Oterium was, to put it bluntly, destroyed. If left as it is, it wouldn't be long before the enemies discovered this scene, and they would naturally investigate. Ameris was conscious of this too.
[The enemy's airships or dragons might pass by here by chance, or they could detect some problem and come to investigate. For now, I will use my power to fill the pit again.]
The explosion that occurred while Jin and Hedo were digging could have been observed from a great distance.
Jin had already considered the case where the enemies recognized that 'something had happened at the Oterium'.
"It's a stopgap measure at best. They can sniff us out and find us at any time. Especially Veradin Ziffel, who can use a power similar to record magic. There's also the unknown ability of Sanna."
[What were you planning to do?]
"To be honest, I started digging with a half-hearted mindset. But if the enemies came, I was going to eliminate all of them. I guess I'll have to keep some people here for the time being."

[Ha-ha, there's no need for that. I will stay here continuously. Do your best to confuse the enemies. If they discover me or they are about to run away with the information, you can request support immediately.]
"Can you teleport?"
[No, I lost that ability along with my head.]
"Then I have no choice but to keep the Red Owl on standby with my people."
[No need for that. My avatar will follow you and live with you from now on. Being in human form is more convenient in many ways, right?]
"Did you say an avatar?"

[Yes. Ha-ha, it's been a long time since I mixed with mortals. It's the best amusement I can enjoy as one who is bound by the destiny of guarding the border. I'm looking forward to it. I'll just create an avatar in my current form.]
Ameris sat down and looked up at Jin and his companions.

[By the way, when I create an avatar, I become the weakest. So if by any chance an enemy comes while I'm creating an avatar, you'll have to protect me. On the other hand, if you want to kill me, there won't be a better chance than now......]
Even though they hadn't known each other for long, Ameris fully trusted Jin and his companions. It was because she was sure that their inner selves were not dangerous.
"I'll take it as a sign of your trust in us, telling us a secret. Please proceed with confidence."
[So be it. It's been a while, so it may take some time. Even while creating the avatar, we can still converse, so there's no need to stay silent.]
"Understood."
As Ameris closed her eyes, a strange grey aura spread around her.
'It's the first time I've seen a power with a grey hue.'
The grey power soon surrounded Ameris in a circle, rippling like water.
[I always feel this when creating an avatar, it's like I'm a snake. Snakes are most vulnerable when they are shedding. It's like creating a moving shell.]
Through the rippling grey aura, scales could be seen forming on Ameris's body. The group watched this spectacle with fascination while conversing with Ameris.
"Snakes often die during the shedding process."
[Sandra Ziffel, that's not something one should say with such an innocent face. It seems there is much I can teach you while we live together.]
The creation of the avatar proceeded smoothly.
However, an unexpected situation arose just after ten minutes.
Jin, Ameris, and Hedo all simultaneously felt a clear killing intent coming from somewhere underground.
"It seems like there's something else underground, Ameris."
As Hedo spoke, Jin focused once more on the sudden killing intent he had started to feel.
'This aura...'
It was because the killing intent felt strangely familiar.
[Oh dear... I didn't think we'd actually get attacked. It seems to be those guys I fought before I went to sleep.]
Suddenly, a stream of red light shot up from where Ameris was sitting. Thanks to Jin swiftly moving Ameris to the side, there was no damage.
And in the chests of the enemies that appeared with the flash of light, there was a glowing red core. Their overall appearance was similar to that of the Nameless Race.
"Ameris... did you forget about us? We didn't think you'd dare create an avatar here."
Jin and his companions recognized their identities at a glance.
They were the ancient Nameless Race.
